data.name: Fahmirah
data.gender_notes: Fahmirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fahmirah is a unique name that combines the words Fahm, meaning understanding, and Mirah, meaning pearl. It symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name Fahmirah carries the meaning “Combination of Fahm and Mirah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahmirah usually hope their child will grow to embody combination of fahm and mirah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic tradition, pearls symbolize the beauty of knowledge and understanding.
data.etymology: Fahmirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Combination of Fahm and Mirah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahmirah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The components of the name reflect the value of knowledge and wisdom in Islamic culture. Education is highly regarded in Islam, and the pursuit of knowledge is considered a lifelong endeavor. Fahmirah represents the individual embarking on this journey and the importance of gaining the pearl of knowledge.

The name embodies the Islamic belief that knowledge is a light that illuminates the path to God and acts as a shield against ignorance and darkness. It emphasizes the crucial importance of understanding God's message and living a life in accordance with His guidance, as well as the significance of personal growth and self-improvement. Furthermore, the name Fahmirah holds the promise of the ultimate reward, a pearl of great value - paradise, earned through the pursuit of knowledge and the plentiful blessings that come from it.
